dct_description_sm: These files contain data and R code associated with the paper “Breeding origin and refueling status influence mercury concentrations in Arctic-breeding shorebirds during southward migration” currently accepted to Contaminants, Environment, and Society. In this paper, we examined mercury concentrations in blood and feathers from juvenile Semipalmated sandpipers (Calidris pusilla) and semipalmated plovers (Charadrius semipalmatus) staging in Atlantic Canada during southbound migration. We assessed the potential influence of breeding origin, fueling status, and diet on mercury burdens.
dct_title_s: Breeding origin and refueling status influence mercury concentrations in Arctic-breeding shorebirds during southward migration
